interjacency.definition:
n. The state of being between; a coming or lying between
   or among; intervention; also, that which lies between.

interjacent.definition:
a. Lying or being between or among; intervening; as,
   interjacent isles.

interject.definition: v. to insert between other elements
interject.translation: vt. 插嘴, 突然插入

interjected.translation:
a. 插入的, 居间的, 补入的
v. （突然）插入, 插话( interject的过去式和过去分词 ); 打断

interjecting.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Interject
interjecting.translation: v. （突然）插入, 插话( interject的现在分词 ); 打断

interjection.definition: n. the action of interjecting or interposing an action or remark that interrupts
interjection.translation: n. 感叹词, 插入语

interjectional.definition:
a. Thrown in between other words or phrases;
   parenthetical; ejaculatory; as, an interjectional remark.
a. Pertaining to, or having the nature of, an
   interjection; consisting of natural and spontaneous exclamations.
interjectional.translation:
a. 感叹的, 感叹词的
[医] 插入的, 居间的

interjectionalize.definition:
v. t. To convert into, or to use as, an
   interjection.
interjectionalize.translation: vt.使变成感叹词(或感叹语)

interjections.definition:
n. an abrupt emphatic exclamation expressing emotion
n. the action of interjecting or interposing an action or remark that interrupts
interjections.translation: n. 叹词, 感叹词( interjection的复数形式 )

interjector.translation: n. 插话者, 插入物

interjectory.translation: a. 感叹的, 感叹词的

interjects.definition: v to insert between other elements
interjects.translation: v. （突然）插入, 插话( interject的第三人称单数 ); 打断

interjob message handler.translation: [计] 作业间信息处理程序

interjoist.definition:
n. The space or interval between two joists.
n. A middle joist or crossbeam.
